## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`, plus the package's own tests) and the build succeeds
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a bug fix has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] A changeset is added for any published package you changed (`npx changeset`; patch for a fix, minor for a feature). Documentation-only changes do not need one
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
